Thank you for bringing this matter to the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. We understand that your complaint concerns a disruption to your companion animal journey and the handling of the departure, and we are treating it as a priority review.

We regret the distress caused and we are examining the sequence of events with the ground team, the cabin service lead, and the supervisor on duty. Our operating standard is that companion animals are moved with care between services, and when the process falls short of that standard, we must respond quickly and clearly. If your carrier, paperwork, or booking notes were not handled as expected, we will trace the record and determine where the breakdown occurred. That review includes the check-in point, the transfer path, and the handoff before departure, because each step is part of one shared responsibility.

<<FACT F119>>

<<FACT F109>>

Please note that any claim tied to a minor injury must be submitted within the applicable filing window, and supporting records should be sent as soon as possible so the case can be assessed without delay. If veterinary attention was needed, include the treatment note, the date of care, and any carrier inspection details you have available. If the issue involved a delayed departure, the standard payout for that incident applies under the current service terms once the review confirms the circumstances match the policy criteria.

We are also asking the operations desk to verify whether any handling notes were missed during transfer. If a special instruction was recorded for your pet, that note should have followed the booking through the full movement chain. Where a service lapse is confirmed, we will move the case to resolution promptly and keep the communication direct. If there is any part of the journey that placed your pet at unnecessary risk, we want that documented now so the response is complete and accurate.

Please send the supporting documents and any flight reference details through the usual claims channel today if possible. Once received, we will progress the file and advise on the next steps without avoidable delay.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
